title: QA_Platform_stage_approval_timeline_empty_for_fresh_stage
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox RFQ stage: published, bid window open, no bids. Caller is the buyer who owns it.
steps: 2. Check the reply is an array.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty array (or one create-trade request when the company holds stages for approval). Never 5xx. Api::V1::TradeController#get_approvals (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:941-961).
rationale: The stage approval panel calls this on every event page; a crash blanks the page.

title: QA_Platform_stage_approval_timeline_unknown_stage_is_not_found
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found' because TradeRequest.find_by_id returns nil (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:944-945).
rationale: A well-formed id with no row must be a clean not-found.

title: QA_Platform_stage_approval_timeline_undecodable_id_is_code_2
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters': the uuid decodes to nil and hits the blank check before the lookup (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:942-943).
rationale: Documents guard order: undecodable is code 2, missing row is code 4.

title: QA_Platform_stage_approval_timeline_malformed_filters_must_not_crash
expectedResult: Should be 200 (filters ignored) or 422. Today CommonFunctions.parse_filters swallows the JSON error and returns nil (lib/common_functions.rb:83-95), create_filter_params leaves the filters nil (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_filter_helper.rb:555-574), and the RFQ branch reads the vendor_ids filter on nil (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5412) so the reply is HTTP 500.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: one bad query parameter takes down the approval panel.

title: QA_Platform_stage_approval_timeline_two_approval_types_must_not_crash
steps: 1. GET the stage approvals filtered by approval_type close_trade and surrogate_bid_create together (URL-encoded JSON).
expectedResult: Should be 200 listing either type. Today the filter is bound with an equals placeholder, an array of two keys expands to a comma list and PostgreSQL rejects the SQL, so HTTP 500 (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5419-5420).
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: the multi-select approval-type filter breaks as soon as two types are picked.

title: QA_Platform_stage_approval_timeline_approval_type_as_text_must_not_crash
steps: 1. GET the stage approvals with approval_type sent as a single string.
expectedResult: Should be 200 or 422. Today the code calls map on the string value, NoMethodError, HTTP 500 (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5419).
rationale: Wrong type in a filter must be rejected, not crash.

title: QA_Platform_stage_approval_timeline_unknown_approval_type_is_empty
steps: 1. GET the stage approvals filtered by an invented approval type.
expectedResult: HTTP 200: unknown keys map to nil, the bid-approval filter matches nothing; stage creation approvals are still returned because the filter applies to bid approvals only (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5419-5423). Never 5xx.
rationale: Pins how unknown filter values behave.

title: QA_Platform_award_approval_not_on_pricing_stage_timeline
preconditions: {{pricingTradeUuid}} is the journey closed RFQ with one submitted bid and an award proposal.
steps: 2. Check no element has approval_key_attribute close_event_group.
expectedResult: HTTP 200; award (proposal) approvals live on the event, so no element has approval_key_attribute close_event_group; only creation or bid-selection approvals appear (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5393-5431). Never 5xx.
rationale: Mixing award approvals into the stage timeline would double-count them.

title: QA_Platform_technical_round_approval_timeline_does_not_crash
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the sandbox technical (RFP) round; only present on an RFP plus RFQ run.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty array (no evaluation submitted yet) from the RFP branch that reads proposals running in approval (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5394-5398). Never 5xx.
rationale: Different code path for technical rounds must also be safe when empty.

title: QA_Platform_stage_approval_timeline_vendor_filter_accepted
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox RFQ stage; {{vendorUuid}} is read only.
steps: 1. GET the stage approvals filtered by one vendor uuid (URL-encoded JSON).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty array on the sandbox; vendor_uuids is decoded into vendor_ids and narrows bid approvals (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5411-5412). Never 5xx.
rationale: The vendor filter of the approval panel must work with a decoded uuid.

title: QA_Platform_event_award_timeline_empty_without_award
preconditions: {{eventGroupUuid}} is the sandbox event: published, no proposals.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty array (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:654-684). Never 5xx.
rationale: Feeds the award approvals side panel.

title: QA_Platform_event_award_timeline_unknown_event_is_code_2
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters': the event lookup returns nil before authorize (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:656-657). Note this endpoint answers 2, the stage endpoint answers 4.
rationale: Clients mapping codes to messages must know the difference.

title: QA_Platform_event_award_timeline_undecodable_event_is_code_2
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:655-657).
rationale: A nil id must match nothing.

title: QA_Platform_event_award_timeline_hostile_lot_no_is_safe
steps: 1. GET the award timeline with an SQL-like lot_no value (URL-encoded).
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an empty array: lot_no is bound as a parameter in the Proposal lot_no scope (app/models/proposal.rb:44). Never 5xx.
rationale: Lot number reaches SQL; it must stay a bound value.

title: QA_Platform_stage_uuid_used_as_event_uuid_never_crashes
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox stage uuid, deliberately sent where an event uuid belongs.
steps: 2. If 200, check every element belongs to the caller company.
expectedResult: Uuids are untyped: the stage id is looked up as an event id. Acceptable: 200 for an own event or none found, 422 code 2 when no event has that id, 422 code 455 for another company event (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:655-658, app/policies/event_group_policy.rb:72-74). Never 5xx.
rationale: Id-space confusion must never leak or crash.

title: QA_Platform_bid_close_flows_for_missing_bid_must_not_crash
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox RFQ stage. The bid id decodes to 999999999 (no such bid).
steps: 1. POST /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/close_bid/approval_workflows with a bid uuid that does not exist and empty PO details.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 4. Today the transform_bid_products before_action finds the stage from the bid when no trade_request_id is sent and calls trade_request on nil, NoMethodError, HTTP 500 (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5548-5551, before_action at app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:26). Read-only endpoint: nothing is written.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: a stale bid link crashes the approval-flow lookup of Select Bid.

title: QA_Platform_bid_close_flows_without_usable_bid_refused
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox RFQ stage owned by the caller, window open.
steps: 1. POST /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/close_bid/approval_workflows with an undecodable bid uuid.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with code 4 (no active bid with that id) or code 101 (the stage only allows closing in the extra closing time); no flows listed (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:919-934, app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:3222-3236).
rationale: With nil bid the before_action falls back to the stage and the action refuses.

title: QA_Platform_bid_close_flows_unknown_stage_refused
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found' from the before_action stage lookup (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5552-5555).
rationale: Unknown stage is a clean not-found.

title: QA_Platform_close_bid_missing_bid_must_not_crash
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox RFQ stage. The bid id decodes to 999999999 (no such bid), so nothing can be closed.
steps: 1. POST /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/close_bid with a bid uuid that does not exist.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 4. Today HTTP 500 from the same before_action as the flow lookup (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:5548-5551). The sandbox stays active with no selected bid.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING on the Select Bid write endpoint.

title: QA_Platform_close_bid_without_bid_refused
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found': the bid lookup returns nil before any permission or approval check (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:4672-4695). Stage unchanged.
rationale: Nothing to approve or close without a bid.

title: QA_Platform_surrogate_flows_without_stage_refused
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with code 2 (Insufficient parameters), or code 455 when the caller lacks approval-flow read permission, which is checked first (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:87-90, app/policies/bid_policy.rb:49-51).
rationale: The surrogate approval drawer depends on this lookup.

title: QA_Platform_surrogate_flows_for_sandbox_stage
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox RFQ stage of the caller company.
steps: 1. GET the surrogate approval flows for {{tradeId}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with an array of TEAM flows for surrogate bid creation, or 422 code 10 when the stage forbids surrogate bids, or 455 without approval-flow read permission (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:87-101, app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:2775-2779). Never 5xx.
rationale: An empty or failed list makes the dashboard skip approval for surrogate bids.

title: QA_Platform_surrogate_flows_unknown_stage_must_not_crash
preconditions: Caller has approval-flow read permission (otherwise 455 comes first).
steps: 1. GET the surrogate approval flows for stage id 999999999.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 4. Today the nil stage is passed to is_surrogate_bidding_and_is_allowed, which calls current_status on nil, HTTP 500 (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:92-96, app/controllers/concerns/bids_controller_helper.rb:2130-2131).
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: when this crashes the dashboard posts the surrogate bid without approval.

title: QA_Platform_surrogate_flows_undecodable_stage_refused
steps: 1. GET the surrogate approval flows with an undecodable stage uuid.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with code 2 (the uuid decodes to nil and hits the blank check) or code 455 without approval-flow read permission (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:89-90).
rationale: Guard order for undecodable ids.

title: QA_Platform_bid_get_approvals_route_has_no_action
expectedResult: HTTP 404: the route exists (config/routes.rb:319) but BidsController defines no get_approvals action, so Rails answers action not found before any callback. Never 5xx, never data.
rationale: Documents a dead route the dashboard app is allowed to call.

title: QA_Platform_award_flows_listed_for_non_draft_proposal
preconditions: {{proposalUuid}} is the journey award proposal created by the run buyer; the buyer is not on an evaluating team (that answers 204 with no body).
steps: 2. If {{approvalFlowUuid}} was used, check it is listed.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with the applicable award flows (team flows if any team flow triggers, else company flows); the lookup checks the creator but not the status (app/controllers/api/proposal_controller.rb:69-77, app/helpers/api/proposal_approval_helper.rb:45-63). Never 5xx.
rationale: A non-empty list does not mean the proposal can still be submitted.

title: QA_Platform_award_flows_unknown_proposal_not_found
preconditions: Caller is not on an evaluating team (that answers 204 first).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found' (app/controllers/api/proposal_controller.rb:72-73).
rationale: Clean not-found for a stale proposal link.

title: QA_Platform_award_flows_undecodable_proposal_not_found
preconditions: Caller is not on an evaluating team.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found': nil id with the creator scope matches nothing (app/controllers/api/proposal_controller.rb:72-73).
rationale: Undecodable id must not match any proposal.

title: QA_Platform_proposal_readback_shows_approval_state
steps: 2. Compare status with the journey award_submit outcome.
expectedResult: HTTP 200; status is requested when it went to approval, selected when awarded directly, draft when never submitted (app/controllers/api/proposal_controller.rb:14-43). Never 5xx.
rationale: Read-back oracle for every award approval case.

title: QA_Platform_resolve_without_resolution_is_734
preconditions: Bogus approver id only (decodes to 999999999); no real approval is touched.
steps: 1. POST resolve_approval with an approver uuid and no resolution.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 734 'Invalid resolution value. Please choose either Approve or Reject.' from the verify_resolution_params before_action, which runs before the approver check (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:6-8, 256-263).
rationale: Guard order: a missing resolution answers 734 even when other fields are also wrong.

title: QA_Platform_resolve_with_button_label_is_734
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 734 'Invalid resolution value. Please choose either Approve or Reject.' (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:259).
rationale: Only accepted and not_accepted are valid.

title: QA_Platform_resolve_with_resolution_list_is_734
steps: 1. POST resolve_approval with resolution sent as an array.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 734 'Invalid resolution value. Please choose either Approve or Reject.' (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:259).
rationale: Wrong type must not be coerced into accepted.

title: QA_Platform_approve_without_approver_is_code_2
steps: 1. POST resolve_approval with resolution accepted and no approver.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:133-137).
rationale: Nothing to resolve without an approver.

title: QA_Platform_reject_without_remarks_is_code_2
steps: 1. POST resolve_approval with resolution not_accepted and no remarks.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' from the before_action, before the approver lookup (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:260-262).
rationale: A rejection must carry a reason; enforced by the backend.

title: QA_Platform_reject_with_blank_remarks_is_code_2
steps: 1. POST resolve_approval with resolution not_accepted and remarks of spaces only.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' because blank remarks count as missing (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:260-262).
rationale: Whitespace is not a reason.

title: QA_Platform_approve_unknown_approver_is_not_found
preconditions: Bogus approver id only (999999999); also covers the force-resolve path, which adds nothing for a missing row.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found': approve returns nil for a missing approver row and resolve_approval_process raises 4 (app/models/approval_workflow/is_approver_methods.rb:23-26, app/controllers/concerns/approval_workflow_controller_helpers/approval_request_controller_helper.rb:13-14).
rationale: Cannot approve something that does not exist or is not yours.

title: QA_Platform_approve_undecodable_approver_is_code_2
steps: 1. POST resolve_approval accepted with an undecodable approver uuid.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters': the approver uuid decodes to nil (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:137).
rationale: Nil after decoding must not resolve any approver.

title: QA_Platform_bulk_resolve_bogus_approvers_refused_whole
steps: 1. POST bulk_resolve accepted for two approvers that do not exist.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found' for the first missing approver; the transaction resolves nothing (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:153-175).
rationale: Bulk must be all-or-nothing.

title: QA_Platform_bulk_resolve_ids_as_text_must_not_crash
preconditions: None. The ids key is not a uuid key, so the string is passed through untouched.
steps: 1. POST bulk_resolve not_accepted with approver_ids sent as one string.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 2. Today approver_ids.each on a String raises NoMethodError; the rescue only maps numeric messages and re-raises, so HTTP 500 (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:158-172).
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: wrong type crashes the bulk decision endpoint.

title: QA_Platform_bulk_resolve_empty_selection_is_code_2
steps: 1. POST bulk_resolve accepted with an empty approver list.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:158).
rationale: The dashboard sends an empty list when no selected row needs the caller.

title: QA_Platform_bulk_resolve_invented_resolution_is_734
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 734 'Invalid resolution value. Please choose either Approve or Reject.' (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:256-259).
rationale: Same resolution guard as single resolve.

title: QA_Platform_withdraw_unknown_request_not_found
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found': the lookup is scoped to pending requests raised by the caller (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:177-179).
rationale: Withdraw must never touch a request that is not yours and pending.

title: QA_Platform_withdraw_undecodable_request_not_found
steps: 1. POST withdraw_approval with an undecodable id.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 4 'Request not found' (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:178-179).
rationale: Nil id must match nothing.

title: QA_Platform_pending_inbox_answers_on_both_engines
expectedResult: On approval flow version v2: HTTP 200 with pending_tasks; on v1: 422 code 101 (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:115-130). Never 5xx.
rationale: Feeds the approvals drawer.

title: QA_Platform_step_details_unknown_request_refused
expectedResult: On v2: HTTP 422 code 4 (request not in the company flows); on v1: 422 code 455 because the policy needs v2 (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:200-204, app/policies/approval_workflow/approval_request_policy.rb:19-21).
rationale: Edit-approvers drawer must not expose other requests.

title: QA_Platform_approver_search_without_query_refused
expectedResult: On v2: HTTP 422 code 2 (query blank, checked before the request lookup); on v1: 422 code 455 (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:227-230).
rationale: An empty search must not list the whole company.

title: QA_Platform_approvals_list_without_format_must_not_crash
preconditions: Company on approval flow version v2 (on v1 the policy answers 455 first).
expectedResult: Should default to json or answer 422. Today generate_response raises Invalid view format for a nil format, HTTP 500 (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:44-57, app/services/base_view_service.rb:10-21).
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: an optional parameter is mandatory by crash.

title: QA_Platform_approvals_list_invented_tab_swallows_error
preconditions: Company on approval flow version v2.
steps: 1. GET /approval_workflow/approval_requests with an invented view_type and file_format json.
expectedResult: Should be 422 code 2. Today the view service returns an error hash that handle_json drops, so the reply is HTTP 200 with null approvals (app/services/approval_requests/view_service.rb:49-52, 116-128). Never 5xx.
rationale: A silent empty inbox hides the error from the client.

title: QA_Platform_add_approvers_empty_list_refused
steps: 1. PATCH approval request 999999999 with an empty additional_steps list.
expectedResult: On v2: HTTP 422 code 2 (additional_steps blank); on v1: 422 code 455 (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:59-65).
rationale: Adding approvers needs at least one step.

title: QA_Platform_add_approvers_unknown_request_refused
preconditions: Bogus request id only; the approver named is the run own buyer.
steps: 1. PATCH approval request 999999999 adding a step with the run buyer as approver.
expectedResult: On v2: HTTP 422 code 4 (request not among the company flows, checked before any step is built); on v1: 422 code 455 (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:67-69).
rationale: Unknown request must be refused before modification.

title: QA_Platform_start_approval_with_nothing_is_code_2
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:10-11, 265-269). This endpoint has no policy check, so these guards are the only protection.
rationale: Parameter guards on an unprotected write endpoint.

title: QA_Platform_start_approval_unknown_record_type_is_888
preconditions: None; record and flow ids are bogus.
steps: 1. POST approval_requests with an invented resource_type.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 888 'Invalid Parameters': the type is not a model with approvals (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:12-14).
rationale: Only approvable record types may be named.

title: QA_Platform_start_approval_unknown_stage_refused
preconditions: None; record and flow ids are bogus.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with code 4 (record not found) or code 888 if the approvable model list was not loaded (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:16-17).
rationale: Not-found guard on the record.

title: QA_Platform_start_approval_on_sandbox_with_unknown_flow_is_523
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox stage of the caller company; the flow id decodes to 999999999 (no such flow).
steps: 1. POST approval_requests for the sandbox stage with flow 999999999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 523 'Invalid Approval': valid_approval_flow returns false for an unknown flow (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_requests_controller.rb:19-20, 271-288); a second guard inside the transaction would also refuse. The stage is unchanged.
rationale: The flow must be one that applies to this record and initiator.

title: QA_Platform_read_unknown_approval_flow_refused
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with code 570 (Approval Flow not found), or code 455 when the caller lacks approval-flow read permission, which is checked first (app/controllers/api/approval_workflow/approval_flows_controller.rb:5-6, 142-145).
rationale: Flow details page must answer a clean not-found.

title: QA_Platform_approval_types_on_offer_are_readable
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with approvals_types including create_trade and close_trade when the trade module is on; close_event_group and technical_evaluation only when rfx projects are enabled for the company (app/helpers/approval_workflow/approval_flow_helper.rb:188-202). 455 without approval-flow read permission. Never 5xx.
rationale: Which approval types a company can configure decides which event approvals can exist.

title: QA_Platform_read_unknown_delegation_refused
expectedResult: HTTP 404 with error code 679 ("Delegation not found"): the lookup runs before the policy (app/controllers/api/delegations_controller.rb:6-11). The runner reads no message from a 404 reply to a read, so only the refusal itself is checked.
rationale: Delegation drawer loads by id.
